summary: Validated deployed My Labels UAE marketing + RFQ + admin dashboard app. Backend: 9/9 pytest tests passed (root, login success/invalid, /auth/me guarded, enquiries create/list/patch with auth). Frontend: Homepage, /products, /industries, /gallery, /faq, /about, /products/:slug all load. Quote form submission on /contact succeeds with success toast; enquiry persists and appears in admin dashboard. Admin login (admin@mylabelsuae.com/admin123) redirects to /admin and Enquiries table renders with stats + rows including the freshly submitted enquiry.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: /api/enquiries/{id} PATCH uses `status` as query param (not body). Works but non-idiomatic; a Pydantic body model would be cleaner.
server.py build_enquiry_email interpolates user input directly into HTML (no escaping). Low risk since email is skipped without EMERGENT_EMAIL_KEY, but should use html.escape when enabled.

AdminPage.jsx: `if (user === false) navigate('/login')` relies on AuthContext exposing false vs null - verify unauthenticated state actually sets user=false, otherwise route is unprotected until token expiry.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 backend test enquiry (TEST_*) and 1 UI test enquiry (UITEST_*) via public POST /api/enquiries. Both visible in admin dashboard.
context_for_next_testing_agent: App fully functional. Backend seeds admin on startup. Email sending skipped (EMERGENT_EMAIL_KEY unset) - expected. Backend tests at /app/backend/tests/test_backend.py can be re-run any time via `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_backend.py -v`.
